measurement: Full Coordinator.dispatch wall time; compilation, fixture construction, coordinator state reset and result serialization excluded. Two warmup passes, eight measured passes, substrate order rotated by pass and case.
decision_comparison: Exact ordered Assignment records and eligibility gate values against ALG.0; any cost difference retained separately, never rounded before dispatch.
domain: Binary64 estimated positions, timestamps and confidence. Boolean gates and stable ID tie breaking are Python host logic; compiled kernel multiplies gates and sums squared position differences. Positions in seeded cases within +/-10 m; named finite large-coordinate and ULP boundary cases are numerical stress fixtures.
provenance: Synthetic observation-interface fixtures, not simulator ground truth, sensor recordings or robot performance results. Entity sources explicitly identify audit fixtures.
claim_limit: Sampled parity only, not universal equivalence, real-time guarantee, physical safety, whole-controller compilation or performance versus learned robot policies. Timing is conditional on this host and concurrent load.
